prompt: I want a caching layer for the HTTP client. It should cache GET responses in memory with a configurable TTL. Cache misses should fetch from the network as normal. Don't cache POST/PUT/DELETE.

assertions.text: A design doc file exists with clear structure
Design doc includes Summary, Motivation, Design, Alternatives, and Testing Plan sections
Design or code explicitly limits caching to GET requests only
Tests cover cache hit, cache miss, and TTL expiry scenarios
Evidence of review/quality pass (clippy, fmt, test commands mentioned)
